$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P1 task `p1-day-freeze-recovery` (packages/core/src/day/**, packages/core/src/streak/**). The integrate task merges every docs/owned/*.json into docs/invariants-owned.json, which is what `pnpm test:coverage-map` reads. INV-DAY-01 and INV-DAY-05 are P0's and stay owned there; this task must not regress them, and `day/rollover.test.ts` carries a test for each showing the whole-day-boundary walk still obeys them.
falsifiers: packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__/<id>.json, one per id, loaded by the test that owns the id and gated by packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__.test.ts
